name: Knowledge Hub
description: A portfolio of analytics projects and research by Mohammad Wasim Shekh — exploring how finance, data, and emerging technologies can be applied to solve real-world business problems.

hero.eyebrow: Business Analytics · Finance · Data Science · AI
hero.heading: How I use models, data, and technology to understand businesses and solve complex problems.
hero.subheading: A resume shows accomplishments. GitHub shows code. This site shows the thinking behind the work — financial models, analytics projects, research, and AI explorations with documented assumptions, methodologies, and lessons learned. From a foundation in banking and finance to business analytics and emerging technologies, this is where I share how I approach complex business problems.

cta.heading: Evaluating candidates for analytics, finance, AI or data-driven role?
cta.body: Spend ten minutes with the models and research here — assumptions, methodology, and lessons learned are documented on every piece. If the thinking holds up, my email inbox is one click away.

models.title: Models
models.intro: Every model here was built from a blank workbook or an empty script. Each one documents the problem it answers, the assumptions behind it, the methodology step by step, and what I'd do differently next time.

research.title: Research
research.intro: Longer-form analysis — from AI-assisted financial document analysis to market and sector economics. Each piece states its question up front, shows its method, and cites its sources.

insights.title: Insights
insights.intro: Short-form analysis on finance, business, data, and technology — exploring patterns, trends, and ideas that emerge while building models, analyzing datasets, and studying real-world business problems. Each insight is grounded in research, evidence, and a data-driven perspective.

about.title: About Me
about.intro: From a bank branch in Nepal to business analytics in New York — a finance-trained analytics professional who believes the best way to understand a business is to analyze it, model it, and continuously improve it.

resume.title: Resume
resume.intro: The one-page version of everything on this site. View it below or download the PDF.
resume.fallback: Your browser can't display embedded PDFs. Use the download button above to get the file.

notFound.title: Content not found
notFound.body: The item you're looking for doesn't exist or may have been moved.

loadError.title: Something went wrong
loadError.body: This page couldn't load its content. If you're opening the files directly from disk, serve the folder with a local server (for example, VS Code Live Server) — browsers block fetch() on the file:// protocol.

footer.blurb: A knowledge hub of financial models, analytics projects, research, and AI explorations — built to show how I think, not just what I've done.
footer.note: Built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks, no build step.
